modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.title: LearningRateSchedule
modelspec.training.LearningRateSchedule.description: How the learning rate varies over steps; a linear warmup over the first warmup_steps steps up to OptimizerConfig.learning_rate (epic:bert-from-scratch, AdamW with warmup).

modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.title: OptimizerConfig
modelspec.training.OptimizerConfig.description: Optimizer hyperparameters, recorded for reproducibility (DESIGN.md § 6.1). The AdamW fields are present exactly when kind is AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, decoupled weight decay); its first and second moments are a checkpoint's optimizer slots (DESIGN.md § 6.2).

learning_rate.description: The base learning rate; the peak rate when a schedule is present.

schedule.description: Absent means a constant learning rate, as M0 SGD has.

x-ess-invariants: ((kind == Sgd and not (defined(weight_decay)) and not (defined(beta1)) and not (defined(beta2)) and not (defined(epsilon))) or (kind == AdamW and defined(weight_decay) and defined(beta1) and defined(beta2) and defined(epsilon)))

modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.title: OptimizerKind
modelspec.training.OptimizerKind.description: SGD from M0; AdamW with weight decay joins at M3 (DESIGN.md § 1, § 11 iteration 4; epic:bert-from-scratch). The CLI accepts only `sgd` until then.
